bio: Unpatrolled 3.6 km surf beach in Great Otway National Park that hosted the 1970 World Surfing Championships.

Extinct volcano 14 km south of Ballarat, with a summit lookout tower giving 360-degree views.
Corio Bay shoreline redeveloped from the old port, with 100-plus painted bollards and a c.1892 steam carousel.
1,250 m summit in Yarra Ranges National Park, the closest snowfield to Melbourne, with a 21 m lookout tower.
